key_notes: Key 1 (t=10.03s): Initial archival pose of sheep; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.

Key 3 (t=12.39s): Peak dynamic extension of sheep over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=13.63s): Follow-through and settle of sheep with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of sheep (10.03s..13.63s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
